subject: Trial on-ramp: evaluation scope, model options & kickoff
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@lingua.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial on-ramp: evaluation scope, model options & kickoff

Hi Emma —

Great to meet yesterday. Quick recap and proposed on‑ramp plan for the 4‑week trial we discussed.

Summary of needs (from call)
- Primary: high-quality instruction-following for customer support summarization and intent extraction
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese (initial); possible future Vietnamese
- Volume: ~30k short messages/day during peak
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for short prompts
- Security: SOC2 scope and data retention questions (see ask #3 below)

Proposed POC plan (high level)
1) Kickoff & data handoff (week 0): Lingua to provide 500–1,000 representative examples + doc of critical edge cases
2) Seed evaluation (week 1): Redwood runs model diagnostics and returns baseline metrics and example outputs
3) Iteration & configuration (weeks 2–3): tune batching, cache, and prompt templates; add fallback routing
4) Final assessment (end of week 4): joint review against success criteria and go/no-go

Success criteria (we recommend measurable targets)
- Instruction adherence: >92% on a curated 200-item instruction set
- Hallucination rate: <3% for factual queries (measured on a 100-item audit set)
- Multilingual parity: Spanish/Portuguese quality drop <=10% relative to English on top-level metrics
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for 95% of requests in dedicated trial capacity
- Cost: estimated token cost <= $0.15 per 1k-generation tokens (we'll optimize batching)

Model selection (initial recommendation)
- Primary: Mistral-Instruct-7B (open, strong instruction tuning, lower cost)
- Fallback: Llama2-13B (quantized variant) for longer-context or higher-precision responses
- For Portuguese tests, consider a small adapter or prompt tuning; if low-resource languages are needed, we'll route through translation + English pipeline as fallback

Ownership & next steps
- Lingua (Emma/Rafael): deliver dataset + security questionnaire
- Redwood (Hannah/Karthik/Grace): provide trial infra, model configs, baseline report
- Proposed kickoff: Mon, Apr 18 — 30min sync. Please confirm availability.

Attachments: POC_success_template.xlsx (template for success criteria), redwood_model_recs.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

— Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com
(415) 555-0197
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial on-ramp: evaluation scope, model options & kickoff

Thanks — a couple quick notes before we send to Lingua:

- Model pick: for support summarization we may want to offer a secondary option of Falcon-40B-Instruct for a higher-accuracy baseline. Call it "Option B" for the report; keep Mistral as default to hit cost targets.
- Latency: p95 <300ms sounds tight for Falcon-40B unless we run on higher-tier Dedicated. I'll flag cost/SLA implications in the pitch.
- Multilingual: recommend we explicitly call out Portuguese (pt-BR) and Latin American Spanish variants; propose an automatic translate+eng fallback for Vietnamese to keep trial scope manageable.

I'll draft the short model comparison table and update the POC template with owner columns (Hannah/Grace) and a simple measurement plan. Quick sync at 2pm PT tomorrow to finalize?

Karthik
Solutions Engineer
From: Emma Liu <emma@lingua.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Soto <rafael@lingua.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial on-ramp: evaluation scope, model options & kickoff

Hi Hannah — thanks for the detailed plan and Karthik for the notes.

We can provide 800 examples and a short edge-case doc by Thursday (Apr 14). Kickoff on Apr 18 at 10am PT works for our team.

A few clarifications:
- Can you confirm whether the trial will run in Redwood Hosted or Dedicated? We need to know the data isolation guarantees for SOC2 scope.
- Portuguese should be pt-BR; Vietnamese is lower priority but we'd like the translation fallback approach documented in the report.
- Can you include an initial cost estimate per 10k requests for both model options (Mistral-7B vs Falcon-40B)? Rafael will own questions on procurement.

Attachments: Lingua_dataset_sample.csv (we'll upload shortly to the shared Drive link)

Thanks — Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Product
Lingua.AI
emma@lingua.ai
